Consumed by home.py once AtinWix/personal is reachable. See the project doc "ESOL Library - Restructure Plan". They were reached from file similarity and names, not from the Hub cards. Runbook 2 is explicit: folder and file names are never used to work out what a lesson was about - read the card. All of them are live or retained lesson material. Check every Hub card before proposing any deletion.
